scope: Adaptive native UI and tablet/mobile web styles

nativeUiBrowserPreview.fixture: Explicitly enabled localhost-only fictional demo; no financial writes or live API calls

additionalChecks: Draft description and amount retained through phone/tablet/split-window resize
Opening-screen authentication actions visible at 320x568, 820x1180, 1366x1024 and 844x390
Web CSS component fixtures at 320, 600, 744, 820, 1024, 1100 and 1366px: no document overflow; tablet dock centered and bounded to 640px
Adaptive geometry: 12 window sizes x font scales 1, 1.3, 1.5, 2, 3
Native navigation unit checks on mocked iOS/Android safe areas and large text
limits: Browser preview uses React Native Web; this does not certify every supported physical device
Native keyboards, camera/photo/file pickers, Apple/Google authentication and store billing need physical-device verification
Foldable-sized cover/inner/split windows covered; hardware hinges, display occlusions and spanning across two physical displays not validated
iPhone Duo interpreted as foldable/dual-screen sizing, not a verified device model
Web CSS fixture checks are not authenticated Next.js end-to-end tests
No Figma changes, production deployment, or store binaries created for this task

layoutRules.compactWindow: Below 600 logical pixels; stacked content and wrapping selectors
layoutRules.mediumWindow: 600–839 logical pixels; measured grids when each item remains readable
layoutRules.expandedWindow: 840+ logical pixels; dashboards bounded to 1120, reading pages to 760, form content to 680
layoutRules.navigation: Centered 640 maximum width; safe-area bottom placement; 72 height or 82 for larger text
layoutRules.sheets: 720 maximum width, scrollable content, no extra top margin below 500 window height
layoutRules.charts: Plot coordinates use measured container width
layoutRules.plans: One, two or three readable cards based on container width and text scale

includes: iOS and Android JS bundle exports
